_about: Offline verdicts per question x model for the admin model comparison (PAR-855). Seeded from the approved mockup's matrix, whose notes summarise ml-bench PR #445 (full period), #447 (driver_level, H5 + TFT level) and #450 (Chronos-2). state: better|worse|unclear|pending, always against what is served today for that question. diff/ciLow/ciHigh only where the run reported them against that reference; never filled in otherwise. expectedBy only for runs still in progress. note: one German sentence, shown when live data does not decide the cell. servedNotes: the note of each question's served (today) cell.
